scope: HITL-002 exact-head safe Approval projection and durable public-process linkage on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.coverage: The public Approval lifecycle preserves caller-safe bounded linkage and state across restart without private tool descriptors or capability values.
observations.limitations: No browser, Stack, Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM is proven.

redaction: No IDs, tokens, descriptors, capability values, credentials, DSNs, or endpoints are retained.
